# Security

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/Youssef2430/BikeTrack/security/advisories/new). Include the affected version and steps to reproduce; omit credentials and personal health data.

Do not post security vulnerabilities in public issues. Ordinary bugs and equipment compatibility reports belong in [Issues](https://github.com/Youssef2430/BikeTrack/issues).
